A '''leech vessel''' was a type of [[starship]] that could be used to board another by cutting straight through its [[hull]].<ref name="Tipping Point">{{TBB|Tipping Point}}</ref> During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|214}}</ref> [[Echo]], [[Fireball (clone trooper)|Fireball]], and [[Nemec]] utilized one such craft, the [[Remora-one|''Remora''-one]], during their [[attack on the prisoner transport ship]] on [[Balmorra]] in order to board a [[Unidentified Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser (Balmorra)|''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] and extract a trio of [[Cloning|clone]]s detained by the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Tipping Point" />
